scenes.title: OpenClaw
scenes.sub: An open-source, self-hosted agent that works with any model.
scenes.say: This is OpenClaw, an open-source agent created by Peter Steinberger and built by its community.

scenes.heading: What it is
bullets: Self-hosted on your machine or server
Works through WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord and more
scenes.say: You host it on your own machine or server, plug in any model, and work with it through WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, and more.

scenes.heading: How it runs
steps: Laptop, homelab, VPS, or cloud workers
API keys, subscriptions, or local models
Chat apps, web, desktop, or mobile
scenes.say: You run its gateway on a laptop, a home server, a VPS, or cloud workers. Bring any model, from API keys, subscriptions, or local models, and talk to it from chat apps or its web, desktop, and mobile apps.

scenes.heading: Timeline
scenes.say: It started in November 2025 as WhatsApp Relay, became OpenClaw in January 2026, and shipped OpenClaw 2.0 on August 30. The latest release is 2026.10.1, from October 10.

scenes.say: VidiFlow. Agent stacks that run your business at scale.
